description: Translate text from one language to another with no API key required. Source defaults to automatic language detection when omitted. Returns the translated text, the detected source language (when auto-detected), and a match-quality score (1.0 = exact translation-memory match, lower = machine-translated). Language codes are ISO 639-1 (e.g. "en", "de", "ja", "zh-CN").

examples.text: The meeting has been postponed until next week

source.description: Source language code, e.g. "en". Omit to auto-detect.

name: mymemory_translate

alternate_matches.description: Up to 3 other candidate translations from the translation memory

detected_source_language.description: Auto-detected source language code, present only when source was omitted

match_quality.description: Translation-memory match score from 0 to 1; 1.0 is an exact match, lower is machine-translated

original_text.description: The original text that was translated

source.description: Source language code, or null when auto-detected

title: Mymemory Translate
